description: Manifest penghubung antara ID VFX, Sprite Karakter/Monster, dan Senjata Paperdoll di Three.js Engine dengan file aset gambar (.webp/.png) di folder assets/. Bila file belum ada, engine otomatis memakai fallback prosedural.

slash_neutral.label: Forge Strike (Tebasan Fisik)
slash_neutral.prompt: RPG melee weapon slash arc effect, glowing golden steel crescent swipe with hot forge sparks, pure black background for additive blending, crisp game VFX texture, no text

slash_fire.label: Searing Cleave (Tebasan Api / Proc)
